freshOnly.reason: Print-agent credentials and the receipts claim timestamp belong to the platform API only; the management-api database has no receipts or cash_registers to pair against.
Indexes the platform-only usage_events table so its nightly TTL sweep stops full-scanning; the management-api database has no usage_events to pair against.
Restaurant-scoped print dispatch and agent device health; the management-api database has no receipts, cash_registers or print_agents to pair against.
market_checkout_sessions exists only in the platform API database; the management API has no corresponding market checkout table.
Webhook ingestion and platform_webhook_logs belong to the platform API; the management API does not receive third-party delivery webhooks.
The platform API owns group-order split-bill writes; the management API has no corresponding group-order settlement workflow to pair against.
Delivery claims are part of the platform API service-crew workflow; the management API has no order-delivery execution surface.
The platform API idempotency middleware owns request reservations; management API has no corresponding idempotency_keys table.
Seat soft deletion and table QR seat management are owned by the platform API; the management API has no corresponding seats table.
Ingredient stock is owned by the platform API inventory module; the management API has no ingredient_definitions table to hang movements off.
Extends the platform-only ingredient stock ledger added in 0011; the management API has no such table.
Coupon codes are a platform-API concern; the management API database has no coupons table to pair the tenant-scoped unique indexes against.
user_coupons is a platform-API table for per-customer coupon instances; the management API database has no such table to pair against.
customer_auth_identities is a platform-API table for consumer sign-in; the management-api database has no customer identity table to pair against.
The tenant-local customer directory is derived from platform API orders and customers; the management-api database has neither source table.
restaurants is a platform-API table; the management-api database has no restaurants row whose business-day boundary could be paired against.
platform_integrations exists only in the platform API database; the management API receives no third-party delivery webhooks and has no integration rows to resolve a store id against.
coupons is a platform-API table; the management-api database has no coupons row whose validity window could be paired against.
restaurant_alerts holds owner-facing operational alerts for platform-API restaurants; the management-api database has no restaurants row to raise or scope an alert against.

ai_insights_cache backs AIInsightsService, which runs against the platform API database; the management-api database has no restaurants row to scope a cached insight report against, and never generates one.

usage_meter_buckets is the write-side half of platform-API metering: it is written by the platform API request path and folded into usage_meters, both of which exist only in the platform database. The management-api database has no usage_events, usage_meters or restaurants rows to pair it against.

reviews stores diner feedback on platform-API orders and recomputes restaurants.rating / menu_items.rating from it; the management-api database has no orders, menu_items or restaurants rows to hang a review off or aggregate into.

Marketing broadcasts fan out platform-API web push to customers who follow a restaurant or a market; the management-api database has no customers, customer_favorites, customer_push_subscriptions, restaurants or markets rows to resolve an audience or scope a send against.

legacyOnly.reason: Legacy operational performance-index migration predates this guard and is reviewed as legacy-only.
